title: linaria repens subsp. blanca
intro: Linaria repens subsp. blanca, commonly known as the Dwarf Toadflax or White Toadflax, is a flowering plant species in the figwort family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the relief of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Linaria repens subsp. blanca are attributed to its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to relax muscles, reduce swelling, and promote the removal of mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
